entities.summary: Theuns Jordaan (b. 1971-01-10, Venterstad) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Venterstad and South Africa. Known in the fields of south africa, composers & musicians, africa.
